scripts.typecheck: node scripts/ensure-assets.ts && wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-assets.ts && vitest run && vitest run -c vitest.worker.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/ensure-assets.ts && vitest run --coverage && vitest run -c vitest.worker.config.ts
scripts.smoke: node scripts/ensure-assets.ts && node scripts/smoke.ts && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
